data.name: 新熱血江湖：世界
data.description_full:
《新熱血江湖：世界》是由熱血江湖IP正版授權的武俠大世界MMO，暌違20年，它不僅是情懷的迴響，更是一段重燃熱血、再續前緣的全新江湖傳奇！那些曾陪伴你度過無數日夜的經典特色，將在《新熱血江湖：世界》中以全新的面貌一一重現，帶你再次蒞臨熱血沸騰、恩怨分明的江湖世界。

【遊戲特色】
【經典正版，全新江湖】
熟悉的江湖味，卻是巔峰級的視覺進化。經典五大職業，重聚泫勃派！次世代引擎重製史詩場景，泫渤派的落櫻、北海冰宮的宿命，經典地圖以超高品質煥然重生。韓飛官、譚花麟邀你歸位，帶上你的神兵，這一次，讓我們以最高規格，重啟你的武林傳奇之路！

【宏大劇情，跌宕起伏】
國語/廣東話雙語劇情配音，TVB配音員傾情演繹！本地化配音帶你沉浸式體驗這跌宕的江湖！你將作為泫勃派弟子，捲入武林最大的權力紛爭。面對「神地」勢力的暗中操弄，唯有深入禁地、集齊奇寶，才能揭開這場驚天大局。這一次，江湖的愛恨情仇由你裁決，這一切的江湖恩怨等你來戰！

【宿命之戰，正邪對決】
行走江湖沒有絕對的非黑即白，但宿命的正邪對決終有一戰！無論是堅守正派的初心，抑或是邪派張狂，當年的恩怨，今朝再次碰撞。這場萬人同屏的巔峰對決，每一場廝殺都是對青春熱血的極致回響。戰吧！爭奪那象徵榮耀的「天下第一」。從今往後江湖規矩由你定義，這段傳奇，等你來續寫！

【打寶致富，跨服交易】
刷寶打怪，打寶鍛造，+15紅裝不在話下！自由擺攤交易，建立公平的交易體系，AI智能風控系統防止通膨，將每一次稀有掉落轉化為實質的江湖資產，這不只是打寶，更是你行走江湖的雄厚資本！

【寵物覺醒，戰場神助】
搜尋江湖中隱藏著各式奇珍異獸，寵物們擁有治療、控場、爆發輸出等獨特技能，將成為你戰鬥中最強大的助力。它們不僅是你的忠實戰鬥夥伴，更是你行走於遼闊江湖中不可或缺的溫暖牽絆！

【江湖路遠，俠義情長】
這不是孤身的冒險，更是與志同道合之士的熱血重逢。你可以隨心組建門派、邂逅靈魂俠侶，在恩怨糾葛中尋得一份並肩而行的溫暖。縱使江湖路遠，只要有情義相伴，處處皆是歸處！

■本遊戲依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔12級。

data.name: People Sort : Flow Puzzle
data.description_full:
Master the sequence and clear the crowd in this strategic color-sorting challenge.

People Sort: Flow Puzzle offers a fresh take on the sorting genre. Instead of static tubes or bottles, you must manage a dynamic flow of passengers as they navigate a narrow track to reach their buses. It is a game of logic, timing, and spatial awareness.

How to Play
The goal is to board every passenger onto the bus that matches their color.

Tap to Move: Tap on groups of colored characters at the bottom of the screen to send them onto the track.

Follow the Track: Characters automatically move along the path toward the loading zone.

Match the Bus: Characters will only board a bus of the same color.

Manage the Sequence: If you send a group that doesn't match the current bus, they will wait on the track. Be careful—if the track fills up and blocks the path for the correct color, you fail the level.

Key Features
Strategic Sorting: Move beyond simple matching. You must plan the correct order of taps to prevent gridlock.

Dynamic Gameplay: Experience a "flow" mechanic where movement and track space are your primary challenges.

Brain-Teasing Levels: Progress through hundreds of puzzles that gradually increase in complexity and require sharper logic.

Clean Visuals: Minimalist 3D design and vibrant colors provide a clear, distraction-free puzzle experience.

Play at Your Pace: No stressful timers. Take your time to analyze the crowd and plan your next move.

The Challenge
As levels progress, the tracks become more winding and the boarding zones more crowded. Success requires looking ahead to see which bus is next in line and ensuring the track stays clear for the right passengers at the right time.

Can you find the perfect order and keep the traffic flowing?
data.description_short: Sort the crowd, clear the path, and fill the buses in this smart puzzle flow!

data.name: Indian Dress Up: Bride Stylist
data.description_full:
Pick the perfect lehenga, layer on the jewels, and go head-to-head against rival stylists to claim the Lovely Bride crown. Indian Bride Dress Up Games puts you in full control of every bridal look, from the skincare routine all the way to the final bindi. Can you out-style the competition?

This is a dress up Indian wedding experience built around real fashion choices. Every outfit, every accessory, and every makeup detail you pick feeds into a live competition score. Style smart, style fast, and walk your bride down the ramp in a look that judges cannot ignore.

What you actually do in the game:

Skincare first. Before a single jewel goes on, you run a relaxing skincare routine to give your bride a glowing base. It sets up the canvas for everything that follows.

Bridal outfit selection. Browse a wide collection of lehengas, sarees, and fusion bridal looks. Mix silhouettes, fabrics, and embroidery styles to build a look that fits the brief for each round.

Makeup studio. Choose eye shadows, lashes, liners, and lipstick shades from a full makeup kit. Subtle daytime bridal or full-on heavy glam, the call is yours.

Hair and color. Match the hairstyle and hair color to the outfit. A messy bun reads differently than a sleek updo, and the judges notice every choice.

Jewelry and accessories. Stack bangles, drop earrings, maang tikka, and nath to complete the look. Even the bindi placement is part of your score.

Fashion fight rounds. Once the look is locked in, your bride walks the ramp and competes directly against other styled brides. Win rounds to unlock pretty outfit categories, lovely jewelry sets, and late amazing makeup palettes.

Why players keep coming back:

The competition format means no two sessions feel the same. Each round brings a different style brief, so the lehenga look that scored high last time might not cut it against an evening reception theme. You have to read the brief, adapt your choices, and execute fast.

The item depth is real. Indian girl dress up games often recycle the same ten outfits. Here, the wardrobe spans traditional bridal red, pastel mint, deep jewel tones, and even indo-western crossover pieces, so there is always a combination you have not tried yet.

The progression is satisfying. Early rounds are forgiving and teach you how makeup layers and outfit pairings interact. Later rounds demand precision, and unlocking a rare jewelry set after a tough win feels genuinely earned.

If you enjoy indian girl makeup games, wedding stylist challenges, or any bridal dress up experience, this game gives you all of that inside a single competitive loop. Get Indian Bride Dress Up Games and show the ramp what real bridal styling looks like.

data.name: Idle Flight Manager
data.description_full:
One small airplane. One route. $120,000 in the bank... That's how every aviation empire starts.

Idle Flight Manager is a live-world airline management game where you draw routes on a real map, buy real aircraft, and watch your fleet grow from a single regional prop plane into a global operation of Boeing 747s and Airbus A380s. Earn revenue around the clock, even while you're offline.

What you do:
Tap airports to design multi-stop routes. Assign a plane and it begins flying the circuit immediately: carrying passengers, landing, turning around, and flying again. The map fills with glowing route lines as your airline expands. Revenue ticks up with every completed leg.

Key features:
📍 Live world map: real-time plane icons move along your routes on a global map that grows as you unlock regions.
✈️ 50+ real aircraft across 10 tiers. From ATR turboprops and Embraer regional jets to Boeing 777s, Airbus A380s, and exotic premium aircrafts.
🌍 9 unlockable world regions. Expand from US domestic routes to international routes: Canada, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania.
💰 Make money while you sleep: flights complete and income accumulates offline; return to a fully loaded airline fleet!
🎯 Random events: crew strikes, tourism booms, fuel price drops, and government subsidies keep operations unpredictable
🚁 Reward drones: spot drone icons flying across the map and tap to collect bonus cash or miles!
🤖 Auto Flight Manager: assigns planes, creates routes, and re-optimizes your entire network automatically.
🛒 Daily used-plane market, 8 rotating listings at steep discounts or spot-buy a rival's plane directly off the live map.

Progression and Fleet Management:
- Level up by completing route circuits and unlock the next tier of aircraft. Manage plane condition carefully. Let it fall below 50% and revenue drops noticeably. Let it fall below 30% and costs stack heavily.
- Set pricing per route to match your strategy. Economy fills every seat at lower fares. Luxury charges almost double per passenger but risks flying half-empty.
- Build hub airports where multiple routes converge to earn a network revenue bonus. Take bank loans to fund bold expansion. Spend miles to unlock countries, each opening new airports and longer, more profitable routes.

The aircraft catalog:
- Start with regional turboprops on short domestic hops. Work through narrow-bodies like the Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A320neo. Progress into wide-bodies such as the Boeing 787 Dreamliner and Airbus A330neo.
- Finally unlock the legendary flagships: the 747-8, the A380plus, and rare premium aircraft for the most ambitious operators. Collect exclusive variants like the Stealth 787, the Golden A380, the Concorde Neo, and the Zero-G Orbiter.

Your airline, always working: Over 150 NPC airlines populate the skies with ambient traffic. Speed boosts let you accelerate to 2x or 10x speed. Every 7 in-game days, a weekly report delivers claimable cash, miles, and route credits. Your fleet never stops, with or without you.

Start your first flight. The world map is waiting.

Hãy kết hợp đội hình và chiến thuật chuẩn xác để đối phó với mọi thử thách. Mỗi lần bảo vệ cửa thành công sẽ đem lại cảm giác thỏa mãn tột độ.

※ Trải nghiệm thị giác độc đáo

Tại sao gã sát thủ cầm cưa máy lại đeo mặt nạ thỏ đáng yêu? Với hàng trăm thiết kế Anh Hùng và Ác Linh riêng biệt, bạn sẽ thấy chúng vừa đáng sợ, lại vừa dễ thương.

※ Hóa thân đa dạng, thách thức mọi bản đồ
Hóa thành thành viên của [Hội Gan Dạ] để thám hiểm những địa danh kỳ bí, từ đoàn tàu đầy Ác Linh, ký túc xá vang vọng tiếng hát đêm, đến hang động ngầm bí ẩn. Người chơi có thể tự do hóa thân thành nhiều nhân vật khác nhau. Hôm nay, bạn sẽ chọn “gương mặt” nào để tham gia vào trò chơi sinh tồn này?

※ Chiến đấu nhanh gọn và kịch tính
Mỗi ván chỉ 5 phút, hoàn toàn không áp lực! Hãy tận hưởng một trận đấu vào những lúc rảnh rỗi. Ngay cả trong thời gian ngắn ngủi, bạn vẫn có thể trải nghiệm game Thủ Thành chất lượng cao một cách dễ dàng nhất.

data.name: aX360e Free
data.description_full:
aX360e is an Xbox 360 emulator designed for the Android platform, with support currently limited to a selection of games. Actual game performance is dependent on your device's hardware capabilities, and most titles may not run at full speed.

aX360e is ported based on the `arm64-backend` branch of Xenia, the well-known Xbox 360 emulator. It also incorporates most of the code from the xenia-canary project (versions 0.6 and later), with dedicated optimizations tailored for the Android platform.

An open-source plan is in place for this application. You can check the progress of the open-source initiative via the link: https://aenu.cc/ax360e/

> **Note** This application is still under active development and may not be compatible with all your favorite games.

This is the free, ad-supported version of aX360e. You can purchase the ad-free version to support the ongoing development of the emulator.

**Important Notice**: This installation package does not contain any game resources. Please export content from your physical Xbox 360 game discs, convert them to **GOD/ISO format files** for use, or directly load files in the supported formats.

---

Key Features
- Supports GOD/ISO game formats (more formats will be added in future updates)
- Vulkan graphics acceleration support
- Talkback accessibility feature compatibility
- Customizable virtual button layout

---

Minimum Hardware Requirements
- Android 9 or higher
- Vulkan graphics API support
- arm64 processor architecture

---

For More Information & User Guides
- Official Website: https://aenu.cc/aX360e/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/aenu1/ax360e
- Reddit Community: https://www.reddit.com/r/aX360e/
- Discord Server: https://discord.gg/TZmJjjWZWH

data.name: Conquian: Classic Card Game
data.description_full:
Conquian is a card game played with a 40-card deck, where the goal is to form melds (sets or runs) of cards. Its name derives from the Spanish phrase "con quién," meaning "with whom," reflecting its interactive and competitive nature. Over the centuries, Conquian has evolved into various forms, including the popular Rummy games we know today.

Step into the world of Conquian, the legendary ancestor of modern Rummy games! Originating in 17th-century Mexico, this traditional card game combines strategic depth with simple rules, making it a timeless favorite across generations.

Key Features:
🌟 Historical Roots: As the precursor to Rummy, Conquian preserves the essence of classic card gameplay while offering a unique cultural experience rooted in Mexican heritage.
🎓 Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: New players can grasp the basics in minutes with our intuitive tutorial. Perfect for quick matches or extended sessions!

data.name: Romantic Goddess

In each level, tiles are arranged in layers on the screen, and players need to carefully pick out three identical tiles to eliminate them. As you move forward, the tile layouts grow more intricate, demanding keener observation, better strategic planning, and deliberate decision-making.
Every level is crafted to be accessible yet increasingly challenging. Success isn’t just about speed; it also hinges on understanding the tile structure and thinking ahead about your moves.

- Undo – Reverse your last move to fix crucial errors
- Remove – Instantly eliminate a selected tile to open up new matching paths
- Shuffle – Rearrange the remaining tiles to discover new solutions
Using these boosters at the right time can significantly boost your odds of clearing more difficult stages without feeling frustrated.
The game boasts dozens of goddess characters, each with multiple story videos that unlock in a sequential manner. The progression system is designed to feel rewarding and well-paced:
- Early story videos can be unlocked for free by reaching specific level milestones
- The final special reward videos require watching an advertisement to unlock
- New goddess characters become available only after you reach certain level progress
This layered unlock mechanism ensures that every completed level brings players closer to new content and meaningful rewards.
The difficulty of levels increases gradually, making the game suitable for both casual players and those who enjoy strategic puzzle challenges. Even if you fail a level, you can retry with improved strategies or make better use of boosters—keeping the experience engaging without overly harsh penalties.
Beyond the core gameplay, Romantic Goddess includes several systems designed to support long-term play:
- Daily check-in rewards to encourage regular play
- Achievement goals that track your progress and accomplishments
These features provide consistent rewards and help maintain player motivation over time.
Romantic Goddess is perfect for players who:
- Love match-3, tile-matching, and puzzle games
- Enjoy games with clear progression and unlockable rewards
- Prefer casual gameplay that can be enjoyed at their own pace
By combining relaxing puzzle mechanics with structured, unlockable story content, Romantic Goddess delivers a balanced experience that’s easy to pick up and rewarding to keep playing. Clear levels, unlock new goddess stories, and embark on a satisfying journey through progressively challenging puzzles.

data.name: Make It 10: Solitaire Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Make It 10: Solitaire Puzzle, where the timeless charm of Solitaire meets a fresh number puzzle twist!

Make It 10 is a free card game that combines classic solitaire flow with clever puzzle mechanics. Match two open cards that add up to 10, clear the board, and use strategy to complete each level.

The rules are simple, but the challenge is deeply satisfying: if two cards total 10, they can be matched and removed. Face cards add an extra layer of strategy — J, Q, and K can only be matched with their own kind. Plan carefully, reveal hidden cards, and make every move count.

Easy to learn but hard to master, Make It 10 offers a rewarding mix of logic, math, and solitaire-style progression. Whether you want a relaxing puzzle session or a real brain challenge, each level brings a new opportunity to test your strategy.

Play through a wide range of beautifully designed layouts, from Pyramid and Flower to Snake and more. With limited moves, changing board setups, and helpful boosters, every level feels fresh and engaging.

HOW TO PLAY:
● Clear the Board: Remove all cards to complete the level.
● Match Cards: Drag one open card onto another. If their values add up to 10, both cards disappear.
● Use the Stock & Bench: Out of moves on the board? Draw from the Stock pile and use the Bench slots wisely to create new matches.
● Plan Ahead: Every level has a limited number of moves, so smart decisions are the key to victory.

GAME FEATURES:
● Match card pairs that add up to 10
● Match J, Q, and K cards with their own kind
● Explore hundreds of unique levels and creative board layouts
● Enjoy a satisfying blend of solitaire, puzzle, card, and logic gameplay
● Reveal hidden cards and discover new strategies with every move
● Use powerful boosters like Hint and Joker when you need help
● Earn Perfect Match bonuses for extra move rewards
● Play relaxing levels or take on harder challenges with limited bench slots
● Smooth controls and elegant visuals for a clean, enjoyable experience
● Easy to play, challenging to master
● Play offline anytime, anywhere
● Compete with players around the world on the leaderboards
● Automatically save your progress and continue anytime

If you love solitaire, puzzle, card, match, math, brain, logic, classic, zen, and number games, Make It 10 is your next addictive challenge.

data.name: ハルメク脳トレ
data.description_full:
『ハルメク脳トレ』は、「ハルメク」からリリースされた、シニアのための脳活性化アプリです！

お好きなパズルを選択！: 集中力を養う「ナンプレ」と、爽快感のある「タイル」から選んで遊べます 。
クリアで応募券を獲得！: パズルをクリアするたび、懸賞に応募できる応募券が獲得できます 。

デイリーチャレンジでボーナス！: 毎日挑戦することでスタンプが貯まり、さらに豪華な報酬がもらえます 。

「最近、物忘れが気になる。楽しく脳の体操をしたい 」
「難しい操作は苦手。シニアに優しい安心できるアプリがいい 」
「家事や仕事の合間に、サクッと気分転換したい 」
「懸賞が大好き！遊ぶだけでお得なことがあると嬉しい 」
「ハルメクの商品やイベントに興味がある 」

本アプリは、シニア女性から圧倒的な信頼を得ている「ハルメク」と、懸賞アプリを運営する「オーテ」が共同運営しています。「ハルメクブランドだから安心 」というお声も多くいただいております。

本当に当たるの？と心配な方は、ぜひアプリ内の「当選者の声」をご覧ください！

何か不具合がございましたら、お手数ですがアプリ内のお問い合わせフォームか、以下までご連絡ください。
form-game@halmek.co.jp

Then the screen fills up.

Whether you’re killing time, trying to focus, or just want something relaxing that still keeps your brain awake, this one does the job.

Pick things up. Match three. Don’t run out of space.

Sounds easy. It’s not.

🔍 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?

👗 Same outfit style or color pattern
👓 Matching accessories — glasses, hats, bags
😄 Similar facial expression or mood
🎨 A shared color, shape, or visual theme
💡 An unexpected "aha!" relationship between objects
The connections start simple. Then they get delightfully tricky.

🌿 Zero Time Pressure — Think at your own pace. No countdown, no stress

data.description_full:
“My Fairy Garden” — การเดินทางที่อบอุ่นใจที่ผสมผสานการจัดการสวนเกษตร ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้และการมีภูตน้อยเป็นเพื่อนคู่ใจ ทุกเมล็ดพันธุ์ที่นี่ล้วนซ่อนเรื่องราว ทุกการพบกันล้วนอบอวนไปด้วยความอบอุ่น

[สร้างบ้านในฝัน จากเมล็ดพันธุ์สู่ดอกไม้บาน]
เริ่มจากพื้นที่เล็กๆ ในการทำสวน ถางที่ดิน หว่านเมล็ด รดน้ำ ใส่ใจดูแลพืชแต่ละต้นอย่างดี ค่อยๆ ขยายสวนของคุณออกไป ออกแบบทางเดินคดเคี้ยว ทิวทัศน์ลดหลั่น สร้างดินแดนวิเศษในป่าที่ดอกไม้เบ่งบานตลอดทั้งสี่ฤดูด้วยมือของคุณเอง

[รวบรวมเมล็ดพันธุ์ดอกไม้พิเศษ สร้างของขวัญศิลปะจากดอกไม้]
สำรวจและรวบรวมดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิดที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ ปลดล็อกคอลเลกชันสมบูรณ์ ปลดปล่อยความคิดสร้างสรรค์ทางศิลปะของคุณ ผสมผสานดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวได้อย่างอิสระ ออกแบบเป็นช่อดอกไม้ แจกันดอกไม้ และของตกแต่งจากดอกไม้งามๆ หลากหลายแบบ เปลี่ยนของขวัญจากป่าเป็นของขวัญที่เก็บรักษาได้

[พบกับภูตน้อยน่ารัก สร้างความผูกพันอันอบอุ่น]
ในป่าอาศัยอยู่ด้วยเพื่อนคู่ใจภูตน้อยผู้บริสุทธิ์ร่าเริงมากมาย ตามหาและชวนพวกเขามาที่บ้านของคุณ พวกเขาไม่เพียงช่วยดูแลพืชผลเท่านั้น ภูตแต่ละตัวยังมีบุคลิกและเรื่องราวเฉพาะตัว รอให้คุณใช้ความอบอุ่นและการดูแลเพื่อปลดล็อก

[ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว กำหนดสไตล์ที่เปลี่ยนแปลงได้ร้อยแบบ]
มีเสื้อผ้าและเฟอร์นิเจอร์มากมายให้คุณเลือกผสมผสาน! จากเสื้อคลุมทำสวนสดชื่นสู่ชุดป่าสวยหรู จากของตกแต่งภายในอบอุ่นสู่ชิ้นส่วนลานบ้านโดดเด่น กำหนดรูปลักษณ์ส่วนตัวและสไตล์บ้านได้อย่างอิสระ แสดงรสนิยมที่ไม่ซ้ำใคร

[แบ่งปันเวลาอันเงียบสงบ สนุกกับสังคมแห่งการช่วยเหลือ]
เยี่ยมเยือนบ้านในป่าของเพื่อน ช่วยกันดูแลพืชผล แลกเปลี่ยนแรงบันดาลใจในการตกแต่ง หรือร่วมกันทำภารกิจพิเศษ แบ่งปันความสุขจากการเก็บเกี่ยวในการโต้ตอบที่เบิกบานและผ่อนคลาย ทำให้การเดินทางไม่เหงาอีกต่อไป

Sphere Stack is a polished ball sort puzzle game that starts simple and quickly becomes a satisfying test of logic, planning, and speed. Tap to move colorful spheres between tubes and sort every color into its own stack. With 600 handcrafted levels, daily puzzles, and the new Time Challenge mode, there is always a fresh puzzle waiting.

Easy to learn, hard to master. Every move matters as new colors, trickier layouts, and tighter limits push your strategy further. Play at your own pace or turn on Time Challenge and race the clock.

Shield system earned through achievements

14 achievements to unlock

Smooth 3D spheres and elegant glass tube visuals

Satisfying sound effects and haptic feedback

Share your results with friends

New in Version 1.1.0: Time Challenge Update
Take on every puzzle in a whole new way with Time Challenge mode. Toggle it from the main menu and turn each level into a race against the clock. Early levels give you room to think, but later stages demand quick decisions and smart moves under pressure.

Run out of time? Shields can give you extra seconds and keep your run alive. Unlock new achievements and prove you can solve under pressure.

How to Play

Tap a tube to pick up the top sphere

Tap another tube to place it

You can only place a sphere on an empty tube or on top of the same color

Sort all spheres by color to complete the level

Finish within par moves to earn 3 stars

Use power-ups when you need help

Whether you want a relaxing brain game or a faster puzzle challenge, Sphere Stack gives you both. Plan carefully, sort efficiently, and see if you can master every level.

data.name: Theme Association: Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
Theme Association: Sort Puzzle is a relaxing puzzle game that challenges your brain to recognize patterns, discover connections, and organize objects into meaningful groups.

In every level, you are presented with a collection of items that belong to different categories. Your goal is to study each object carefully and place it with others that share the same category. Some puzzles are simple, while others require deeper thinking to identify the correct relationships.

Unlike traditional sorting games that focus only on colors or shapes, Theme Association encourages players to think conceptually. The challenge comes from recognizing how objects relate to one another and understanding the category they belong to.

This unique puzzle mechanic turns each level into a small logic challenge. You must analyze the objects, eliminate incorrect matches, and gradually organize everything into clear categories.

The gameplay is designed to be relaxing and enjoyable for players of all skill levels. Simple controls allow you to move objects easily, while the gradually increasing puzzle complexity keeps the game engaging.

As you progress, new puzzles introduce more objects, more categories, and more interesting combinations. This keeps the experience fresh while providing a steady sense of improvement and mastery.

One of the most satisfying aspects of Theme Association is the moment when a puzzle finally becomes clear. What first appears as a random collection of items slowly reveals its hidden structure as you begin to organize everything correctly.

The clean visual design helps players focus on the puzzle itself. Bright icons, simple layouts, and smooth interactions make every level easy to understand and enjoyable to solve.

Theme Association is perfect for players who enjoy brain training games, relaxing puzzles, and thoughtful challenges that reward observation and logical thinking.

Whether you want to exercise your mind for a few minutes or relax with a longer puzzle session, Theme Association offers a calm and satisfying experience.

Key Features of Theme Association: Sort Puzzle

• Category based puzzle gameplay
• Discover connections between objects
• Organize items into logical categories
• Relaxing brain puzzles with no time limits
• Simple controls and clear visuals
• Increasing challenge across many levels
• Perfect for casual puzzle players
• Designed for relaxing and thoughtful gameplay

Train your brain, sharpen your observation skills, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving clever puzzles.

Download Theme Association: Sort Puzzle and experience a new kind of relaxing logic puzzle.
data.description_short: Sort objects by category, train your brain, and enjoy relaxing logic puzzles.

Pistol, machine gun, or a heavy skull crusher? Choose your weapon from a devastating arsenal of this action adventure. Use different fighting styles to win every gang fight and prove you are the king of wilderness survival. This post apocalyptic world respects only power.

Go on dangerous raids for scrap metal and rare resources. Each raid is a unique challenge in the apocalypse max era! Locations with enemies at every turn await you. Only by winning a gang fight can you secure your shelter and solve the mystery of the scorched earth.

👫 SAVE OTHER SURVIVORS

In this post apocalyptic RPG, it is important to join forces. Save other survivors from a lawless gang and protect them from the desert war dangers. Go with them for scrap metal and hunt for bosses in the best tradition of action games. Together, you can survive the apocalypse max nightmare.

🌵 PREPARE FOR THE GANG FIGHT

In Skullburn: Action Adventure, when the sun goes down over the scorched earth, you will need all your wilderness survival skills to escape from wasteland punk mutants. Prepare your skull crusher and gather your ammo for the most intense desert war of your life.

Search for clues to learn the history of this post apocalyptic wasteland. Find out what triggered the apocalypse max and why the desert war never ends. In these adventure, every letter found on the scorched earth brings you closer to the truth.

In Skullburn: Post Apocalyptic survival, every moment is a desperate struggle to maintain your wilderness survival. Explore the scorched earth and lawless ruins in one of the most intense apocalypse survival games and action adventure titles. Skullburn is a free-to-play action adventure where every piece of scrap metal matters. Test your courage in one of the most chilling apocalypse survival games. Only the bravest will manage wilderness survival in this post apocalyptic world of wasteland punk and desert war.

data.name: Muse Gallery
data.description_full:
Muse Gallery
A casual puzzle game that combines stacked match-3 gameplay with a progressive story video unlock mechanism. By clearing levels, you can gradually unlock exclusive story content for multiple muses with different styles. While enjoying a relaxed puzzle-solving experience, you will gain a clear sense of in-game progression and long-term motivation to play.
Classic Stacked Match-3 Gameplay
The game centers on the popular stacked tile match-3 mechanism. In each level, tiles are stacked in multiple layers on the screen, and you need to carefully select and collect three identical tiles to clear them. As you progress through the levels, the tile layouts become more complex, requiring sharper observation, more thorough planning, and more prudent decision-making.
Each level is designed to be both easy to pick up and progressively challenging. The key to clearing levels lies not only in speed but also in understanding the tile structure and planning each move in advance.
Practical Boosters for Strategic Level-Clearing
To help you overcome difficult levels, Muse Gallery offers three practical boosters:
Undo: Undo your last move and correct critical mistakes
Remove: Directly eliminate selected tiles to open up new matching paths
Shuffle: Rearrange the remaining tiles to discover new matching solutions
Using boosters at the right time can greatly increase your chances of clearing levels, allowing you to successfully overcome difficulties without feeling frustrated.
Muse Characters and Story Unlock Mechanism
The game features dozens of unique muses, each with a series of story videos that can be unlocked in sequence. The progression system is designed to be both rewarding and well-paced:
Reach specified level milestones to unlock early story videos for free.
Watch a short video ad to unlock the final exclusive reward story videos.
New muses can only be unlocked after reaching a certain level of progress.
This layered unlock mechanism ensures that every level you complete brings you closer to new content and valuable rewards.
Progressive Level Difficulty
The difficulty of the levels increases steadily, making it suitable for both casual players and those who are keen on strategic puzzle challenges. Even if you fail a level, you can retry with adjusted strategies or optimize the use of boosters, maintaining the fun of the game throughout without severe penalties.
Special Mechanisms for Long-Term Gameplay
In addition to the core gameplay, Muse Gallery also includes a variety of mechanisms to support long-term gameplay:
Daily Check-In Rewards: Encourage players to log in daily with stable benefits.
Achievement Goals: Record every step of your growth and milestone moments.
These mechanisms provide continuous reward feedback and maintain your motivation to play in the long run.
Who Is This Game For?
Muse Gallery is especially suitable for players who:
Love match-3, tile-matching, and various puzzle games
Enjoy games with clear progression and unlockable reward mechanisms
Prefer casual games with a free rhythm that can be played on demand
By combining relaxed puzzle-solving gameplay with structured story unlock content, Muse Gallery creates a balanced gaming experience—easy to pick up, yet worth investing in for the long term. Clear levels, unlock new muse stories, and embark on a pleasant exploration journey through progressively challenging puzzles.

data.name: 青丘世界：緣起
data.description_full:
下一次遇見，在青丘世界。
2026 年旗艦級 3D 仙俠大作《青丘世界：緣起》，以超高精度建模與動態光影系統，重構東方仙俠的浪漫與壯闊。
你將化身守令一脈的末代弟子，執掌殘缺的御妖令。朱雀精魄蠢動，上古封印將破——斬妖除魔之外，更要揭開塗山氏一族世代守護的禁忌真相。諸神不臨，仙妖對峙，你的每一次選擇，都將改寫這場劫數的終局。
踏入青丘，一草一木皆靈韻，一顰一笑盡風華，在仙霧縈繞的山海間，展開屬於你的緣起之旅。

【四大職業・各具其風采】
靈狐、劍仙、逐月、龍槍——四大職業各擁獨特的戰鬥美學。
每個宗門皆配備專屬技能與覺醒造型，並可自由搭配祕法絕技，讓你創造屬於自己的仙俠風骨。

【遇見青丘・尋覓大世界】
這是一個兼具絕美風景與溫暖人情的開放仙界。你將與好友一同御劍乘風、踏雲尋蹤，一步一景，處處驚鴻，在湖邊共許願，在秘境中探險。
告別單機式修仙，讓每一次相遇，都成為牽絆的開端。

【靈韻天成 · 一顏一世界】
高自由度捏臉系統，從眉眼輪廓、衣飾妝容皆由你親手定製。從清冷仙君到嬌萌靈狐，你所思念的模樣，從此躍然於指尖。
一顏一鏡，照見獨一無二的你。

【百妖通靈・掌馭由汝心】
遊戲內藏匿著形形色色的妖靈——或憨態可掬，或威風凜凜，各具性情。你將邂逅、馴化並與牠們共生，結下獨一無二的羈絆。
每一隻妖靈皆擁有獨立的養成與進化路線，你將攜同心愛的妖靈並肩作戰，縱橫仙魔戰場。

【霓裳玉羽・纖毫畢現之美】
極致畫質，為每一件時裝賦予靈魂。綢緞的流動、輕紗的透光、金屬的冷冽、羽翼的豐盈——材質細膩到每一縷絲線。
數千款時裝配件自由搭配，更支援百萬種自由染色，隨心搭配，告別撞衫。在青丘世界，你可以比世界更多彩。

【繁花為禮・情深到家】
遊戲內外，好禮相連。在預約活動頁參與「繁花大賽」活動，或與心上人在遊戲中結成情緣，即可額外獲得真實鮮花豪禮——百萬鮮花宅配到家，讓浪漫從虛實之間綻放於眼前。

※ 本軟體因涉及暴力、戀愛交友 、性（遊戲角色穿著凸顯性特徵之服飾），依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔12級。
※ 本遊戲為免費使用，遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務。
※ 長時間進行遊戲，請注意使用時間，避免沉迷於遊戲。

data.name: Wooden Escape
data.description_full:
Step into the calm and clever world of Wooden Escape, a puzzle adventure where logic, timing, and careful thinking guide you through beautifully crafted wooden mazes.
Each level presents a board filled with wooden arrows pointing in different directions. Your objective is simple: follow the correct order, clear the arrows, and gradually open a path to escape the maze. As each arrow moves away, new routes appear and the puzzle slowly reveals its solution.
At first the puzzles seem straightforward, but the wooden maze quickly becomes more complex. Arrows block each other, paths twist and overlap, and one wrong move can leave you stuck. Finding the right sequence requires observation, patience, and smart planning.
Every solved puzzle creates a satisfying chain of movement as the arrows slide away and the board clears step by step. Watching the path open and the maze unravel is both relaxing and rewarding.
The warm wooden visuals create a calm atmosphere that makes every puzzle enjoyable to explore. Smooth animations and simple tap controls keep the gameplay intuitive while the challenges gradually grow more intricate.
As you progress, you’ll encounter new maze layouts, tighter spaces, and more complicated arrow arrangements that test your logic and puzzle-solving skills. Each level is designed to be easy to understand but challenging to master.
Whether you enjoy relaxing brain teasers, maze puzzles, or satisfying logic games, Wooden Escape offers a peaceful yet engaging experience that keeps your mind active while remaining easy to play anytime.

data.name: Tabu Oyna - Reklamsız
data.description_full:
Arkadaş ortamlarının ve aile toplantılarının vazgeçilmezi klasik kelime anlatma deneyimi artık cebinde!
Tabu Oyna, binlerce güncel kelimesi, minimalist tasarımı ve tamamen reklamsız oyun sayfası ile en akıcı kelime oyunu deneyimini sunar. Kelime hazneni test et, yaratıcılığını konuştur ve yasaklı kelimelere takılmadan takımını galibiyete taşı!

🌟 NEDEN tabooyna?
Piyasadaki karmaşık ve reklam dolu oyunlardan sıkıldın mı? Tabooyna, kullanıcı dostu arayüzü ve sade yapısıyla doğrudan eğlenceye odaklanır.
• Oyun Ekranında Reklam Yok: Oyunun en heyecanlı yerinde reklamla bölünmezsin. Kesintisiz bir oyun deneyimi sunuyoruz.
• Geniş ve Güncel Kelime Arşivi: Binlerce farklı kelime ve sürekli güncellenen kategorilerle her oyun yeni bir heyecan.
• Tamamen Ücretsiz: Tüm özelliklere ve kelime paketlerine hiçbir ücret ödemeden erişebilirsin.

🎮 OYUN ÖZELLİKLERİ VE ÖZELLEŞTİRME
Oyunu kendi kurallarına göre oyna! Esnek ayarlarımız sayesinde kontrol tamamen sende:
• Süre Ayarı: İster 30 saniyelik hızlı turlar, ister 2 dakikalık detaylı anlatımlar.
• Pas Hakkı: Zorlandığın kelimeleri stratejik olarak pas geç.
• Zorluk Seviyeleri: Kolay, orta ve zor seçenekleriyle her yaş grubuna ve bilgi seviyesine uygun oyun modu.
• Farklı Kategoriler: Spor, Sanat, Tarih, Teknoloji, Günlük Hayat ve popüler kültür temalı özel paketler.

🧠 EĞİTİCİ VE SOSYAL FAYDALARI
Bu sadece bir oyun değil, aynı zamanda bir zihin egzersizi:
• Kelime Dağarcığı: Yeni kelimeler öğrenerek kendini ifade etme yeteneğini geliştir.
• Hızlı Düşünme: Zamana karşı yarışırken beynini daha hızlı çalışmaya zorla.
• Yaratıcılık: Yasaklı kelimeleri kullanmadan anlatım yaparken sınırlarını zorla.
• Ekip Ruhu: Arkadaşlarınla ve ailenle bağlarını güçlendir, rekabetin tadını çıkar.

🎯 NASIL OYNANIR? (Kısaca)
• Takımları Kur: Arkadaşlarını iki gruba ayır ve takım isimlerini belirle.
• Ayarları Yap: Süreyi, pas sayısını ve kategoriyi seçerek oyunu başlat.
• Anlatmaya Başla: Yukarıdaki ana kelimeyi, altındaki "yasaklı kelimeleri" kullanmadan takım arkadaşına anlatmaya çalış.
• Skoru Takip Et: Doğru tahminlerle puan kazan, yasaklı kelime kullanırsan puan kaybedersin!

Hemen indir, takımı topla ve eğlenceyi başlat! Merak etme ben seni tutuyorum. İyi oyunlar! 🎉

"Trong một thế giới đầy rẫy kẻ xấu và sự chia rẽ xã hội ngày càng gia tăng, bạn được cử đến Đảo Lưu Đày - nơi kẻ xấu bị đày ải cách xa nền văn minh - và đối mặt với thách thức biến hỗn loạn thành trật tự.

Xắn tay áo lên - đã đến lúc chứng minh bạn là người Quản Trại có thể kiểm soát mọi thứ!

Với vai trò là Quản Trại, trách nhiệm của bạn bao gồm:
**Quản Lý Kẻ Xấu**
Bạn chịu trách nhiệm giám sát mọi khía cạnh trong cuộc sống của kẻ xấu, từ lịch ăn uống đến nhiệm vụ công việc. Các quyết định chiến lược của bạn rất quan trọng, ảnh hưởng đến sự cân bằng giữa ổn định và hỗn loạn.

**Truy Bắt Kẻ Đào Tẩu**
Với những tên kẻ đào tẩu nguy hiểm vẫn còn nhởn nhơ ngoài vòng pháp luật, bạn cần truy lùng và bắt chúng trở lại. Sau khi bị bắt, những kẻ đào tẩu nguy hiểm này có thể bắt đầu làm việc, giúp bạn duy trì trật tự và hiệu quả trong Hệ Thống.

**Đảm Bảo Trật Tự và Lợi Nhuận**
Điều hành một Hệ Thống thành công không chỉ đòi hỏi sức mạnh thể chất mà còn cần một bộ óc nhạy bén. Quản lý ngân sách của bạn một cách khôn ngoan, nâng cấp cơ sở vật chất và biến Hệ Thống thành một lợi nhuận, đồng thời giữ cho kẻ xấu tuân thủ các quy tắc và mọi thứ diễn ra suôn sẻ.

Thể hiện kỹ năng chỉ huy của bạn và khẳng định mình là người có quyền uy cao nhất-Địa vị của Quản Trại!"

data.name: Five Nights at Freddy's Fnaf
data.description_full:
No longer trapped in the pizzeria—they’re inside your house
You thought you left the nightmare behind when you quit your job as a security guard. You were wrong. The animatronic monsters have found where you live, and now the ultimate survival horror challenge begins in your own bedroom.

In Five Nights at Freddy's Fnaf, the rules have changed. There are no security cameras to hide behind and no power grid to manage. You only have your senses, a flickering flashlight, and your instincts.

CAN YOU SURVIVE?
The hallway is quiet... too quiet. Use your ears to listen for breathing at the doors. If you hear something, shut the door immediately! If the coast is clear, use your flashlight to scare away the creatures lurking in the shadows. But be careful—if you flash your light while they are at the door, it’s game over.

GAME FEATURES:

Immersive Home Horror – Experience a terrifying “home invasion” atmosphere where nowhere feels safe—not the closet, not the bed, and definitely not the hallway.

Sound-Based Gameplay – This is a game of high-tension listening. Use headphones to hear the mechanical footsteps and sinister breathing of the nightmare animatronics.

Hidden Lore – Collect secret items around the house to piece together the story of why these machines are hunting you specifically.

The Closet & The Bed – They aren’t just coming from the doors. Check behind you and keep an eye on the closet. Something is hiding in the plushies.

Five Nights at Freddy's Fnaf brings the legendary jump-scare mechanics to a domestic setting. It’s a test of nerves, timing, and courage for fans of Freddy’s House, FNAF and animatronic survival horror.
data.description_short: Feel the fear in an ultimate Fnaf security breach augmented horror nightmare!

data.name: Sky Build
data.description_full:
Feel the thrill with Sky Build and test your reaction speed! 🏗️⚡ Your task is to fill all three slots with the same symbol before time runs out.

The slots with three symbols quickly and cyclically change icons 🔄 Tap on a slot to lock the current symbol and tapping again will unlock it, but it will cost you 2 seconds ⏳ Plan your actions carefully, because every second counts.

Once all three slots are locked, the result is checked 🎯 If the symbols match, you win! If not, the slots will automatically unlock, giving you a chance to try again. For the daring, there is a “build” button 🚀 that locks all slots at once — a risky but sometimes very profitable move.

When the time runs out, the symbols are fixed where they stopped ⏱️ If they are the same, you win; if they are different, the game is over. Each level has a different time limit and the first stages are a little easier to start with. Sky Build is all about speed, strategy and excitement in every round!
data.description_short: Block 3 identical symbols and make it before time runs out in Sky Build game!

data.name: Fast Math: Brain Training
data.description_full:
Looking for a real mental workout? Think your brain is fast enough to beat the ultimate countdown?

Fast Math: Brain Training is a lightning-speed cognitive development and mental arithmetic game designed to push your focus, memory, and reflexes to their absolute limits. Whether you are a student looking to ace exams, an adult aiming to keep your mind sharp, or a competitive puzzle solver—Fast Math delivers a brutal, dopamine-fueled brain workout that takes just minutes a day.

What started as a simple speed calculation app has evolved into a complete 3-in-1 brain training suite. We’ve overhauled the experience, adding brand-new cognitive modules and expanding the difficulty tiers to challenge everyone from casual players to mathematical geniuses.

🧠 3 DYNAMIC GAME MODES TO ENGAGE YOUR BRAIN

1. FAST MATH (The Classic Arithmetic Blitz)
Face down a relentless barrage of speed arithmetic. Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems fly at you in real-time. Calculate instantly, tap the correct answer, and reset the clock. One millisecond of hesitation means game over.

2. NUMBER CHASE (Visual & Spatial Processing)
A chaotic grid of randomized numbers appears on screen. Your mission? Tap them in ascending order from smallest to largest before the timer expires. This mode actively trains your peripheral vision, spatial awareness, and rapid visual scanning capabilities. It sounds easy—until the grid expands and the clock speeds up.

3. PATTERN FINDER (Logical Reasoning & Sequence Recognition)
Uncover the hidden logic. Analyze a sequence of numbers, identify the mathematical rule governing the progression, and fill in the missing link. This mode exercises your prefrontal cortex, enhancing fluid intelligence, inductive reasoning, and abstract problem-solving skills.

🔥 5 LEVELS OF DIFFICULTY: FROM EASY TO INFERNO

• EASY: Perfect for kids, beginners, or a relaxed morning brain warm-up.
• MEDIUM: The standard experience. Sharpens your reflexes and keeps your mind agile.
• HARD: The numbers get larger, the operations get complex, and the timer gets brutal.
• EXTREME [NEW]: Designed only for elite mental calculators. Requires split-second processing.
• INFERNO [NEW]: A psychological crucible. The timer is punishingly fast, the patterns are intricate, and one minor slip ends your high score. Do you have the cognitive stamina to survive?

⚡ CORE GAMEPLAY FEATURES

• HIGH-STAKES LIVES SYSTEM: You start with 3 lives. A wrong answer or a timeout costs you one. When you hit zero, it’s game over—unless you watch an ad to keep your streak alive.
• LOCAL LEADERBOARDS: Every game is logged. Monitor your cognitive growth, track your personal bests, and watch your reaction times plummet over weeks of daily practice.
• ZERO DISTRACTIONS: No clunky menus, no mandatory tutorials, and no bloatware. Just raw performance training between you and the clock.
• IMMERSIVE FEEDBACK LOOP: Dynamic haptic vibration and crisp audio cues confirm your wins or punish your mistakes. Toggle sound and vibration seamlessly mid-game to match your environment.
• 100% OFFLINE CAPABILITY: No internet? No problem. Train your brain on your morning commute, on flights, or off the grid. Fast Math runs entirely local.
• ULTRA-LIGHTWEIGHT ENGINE: Optimized to run flawlessly on any Android device without draining your battery or hogging storage space.

WHY MAKE FAST MATH YOUR DAILY HABIT?
✓ Accelerates mental math calculation speed and numerical fluency.
✓ Boosts short-term memory, working memory, and executive function.
✓ Enhances daily focus, situational awareness, and attention to detail.
✓ Perfect for standardized test prep (SAT, GMAT, CAT, GRE, or banking exams).
✓ An engaging, productive alternative to mindless social media scrolling.

Stop letting your brain run on autopilot. Challenge your intellect, accelerate your processing speed & see how sharp your mind truly is.

Download Fast Math: Brain Training today and unleash your inner calculator! 🧠⚡

• รวมพลังเพื่อนร่วมทีม สร้างทีมที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุด

จาก อาลาบาสตา ไปยังซากเกาะท้องฟ้า จากคุกใต้ทะเล ถึงสงครามมารีนฟอร์ด ทุกการเดินทางเต็มไปด้วยความท้าทายและความมันส์

ต่อสู้กับผู้เล่นจากทั่วโลกเพื่อแย่งชิงทะเล ยึดเกาะทรัพยากร และชิงธงทะเล
มีเพียงผู้แข็งแกร่งจริงเท่านั้นที่จะได้รับเกียรติ “สี่จักรพรรดิใหม่”

• ระบบการเติบโตที่สมบูรณ์ ก้าวข้ามขีดจำกัด
ปลุกพลังแผนที่ดวงดาว เสริมทักษะเฉพาะตัว พัฒนาความสัมพันธ์ ฝึกฝนเพื่อนร่วมทีมหลักหลายมิติ
เส้นทางการเติบโตที่แตกต่างสร้างรูปแบบกลยุทธ์หลากหลาย ควบคุมทิศทางของการต่อสู้ได้อย่างเต็มที่

จากกัปตันหน้าใหม่ที่ยังไม่เป็นที่รู้จัก
สู่เจ้าแห่งท้องทะเลผู้สั่นสะเทือนโลกใหม่——
ท้องทะเลนี้ จะจารึกชื่อของคุณตลอดกาล

data.name: Tube Master
data.description_full:
🧪 Tube Master: The Ultimate Color Sorting Challenge
Challenge your logic and embark on a vibrant, therapeutic journey at your fingertips!

Looking for a puzzle game that’s both relaxing and brain-teasing? Tube Master is the ultimate color-sorting feast designed just for you! With simple taps and pours, experience the sheer satisfaction of watching colorful fluids flow and settle into perfect order.

🌟 Game Highlights
Simple Controls, Pure Satisfaction: Just one finger is all you need. Tap any tube to pour. It’s easy to pick up, but becoming a true "Master" is the real challenge!

Thousands of Levels: From beginner-friendly starts to hardcore multi-layered puzzles, explore thousands of meticulously designed levels.

Stress-Free Gameplay: No timers, no penalties. Made a mistake? Don't sweat it—undo your move or restart the level anytime. Play at your own pace.

Stunning Visuals & ASMR Audio: Enjoy silky-smooth pouring animations paired with crisp water sound effects. A true feast for your eyes and ears.

Play Anywhere: No internet? No problem. Enjoy the brain-teasing fun offline, anytime, anywhere.

🎮 How to Play
Tap any tube to pour the top layer of liquid into another tube.

You can only pour if the top colors match and the target tube has enough space.

The goal is to sort all colors perfectly—each tube should contain only one solid color.

Stuck? Use the "Add Tube" power-up or the "Undo" button to find a new strategy!

"In Tube Master, every drop is a piece of the logic puzzle waiting to be solved."

Download Tube Master now, start your laboratory experiment, and see how many levels you can conquer!

data.name: Hello Angry Neighbor Stories
data.description_full:
Uncover the Mystery of Angry Neighbor – A Thrilling Sneak-and-Search Adventure!

Right across the street sits the strangest house on the block… the home of Angry Neighbor 🏠🔍. Angry Neighbor is always grumpy, keeps every window boarded up, and paces around muttering to himself. Late at night you sometimes hear odd noises drifting over—strange thumps, muffled sounds, maybe even distant cries. What exactly is Angry Neighbor hiding in there? A forgotten treasure? A secret workshop? A wild story no one else knows? The only way to find out… is to sneak inside.

You become the ultimate curious detective. Slip through unlocked doors and open windows while Angry Neighbor roams his own house. One second he’s sitting on the couch watching TV 📺, the next he’s stomping around checking every corner. If he spots you—zoom! He charges after you in the funniest, fastest chase ever 😅🏃‍♂️. Getting caught? No big deal—just a quick laugh and you respawn outside, ready to try a smarter route.

The whole five-story house is your playground:

Hunt for colorful keys to unlock new rooms and floors!

Climb shelves, crawl under tables, squeeze through vents.

Hide in closets, behind doors, or anywhere dark and quiet.

Solve simple puzzles—move boxes, flip switches, find hidden levers.

Oops… broke a window? Angry Neighbor hears the crash and comes running fast!

Bright, colorful 3D graphics make every room feel alive—cluttered living rooms, messy kitchens, shadowy basements full of surprises. Scattered everywhere are glowing mystery cubes ✨. Collect them all and you’ll unlock secret paths, bonus areas, and extra pieces of the story.

Deep in the basement waits the biggest puzzle of all: a thick brick wall you can actually smash through 🧱💥. What’s on the other side? Clues to why Angry Neighbor acts so strange, explanations for those nighttime noises, maybe even the real reason behind his permanent frown 😠. Some players discover hidden endings by finding every cube, reading every note, and staying one step ahead of Angry Neighbor the whole time.

Hello Angry Neighbor Stories Horror mixes perfect hide-and-seek tension with clever exploration and plenty of silly chase moments. No monsters, no jump scares—just the excitement of sneaking, the thrill of almost getting caught, and the satisfaction of slowly piecing together the mystery of the grumpiest neighbor around.

Ready to become the sneakiest detective in the neighborhood?
Dive in, outsmart Angry Neighbor, collect every secret, and finally uncover what’s really going on behind those boarded-up windows 🔍🏠.

Play Hello Angry Neighbor Stories Horror now—because the best stories are the ones you discover yourself! 🚪✨

How to play Solitaria:

• scan the open cards and find words that can be combined into a semantic cluster;
• collect all related terms in one stack, starting with the golden category card;
• clear bottom cards to access those lying above — just like in classic solitaire;
• if there is nothing left to group on the board, draw cards from the deck and repeat the arranging process with new words and images;
• keep in mind that only terms and images with a common theme can be combined;
• try to save moves and empty card slots, cause if you run out of space, you'll get stuck;
• when there are no moves left or the attempt limit is reached, use hints or restart the level;
• if you manage to correctly link all associations and no cards remain on the field — congratulations, you’ve won!

data.name: Tile Hole Master
data.description_full:
Tile Hole Master is a structured tile puzzle where you control a moving hole to swallow tiles and clear the board. Each level presents a carefully arranged tile layout that requires precise movement, smart positioning, and strategic board clearing.
In Tile Hole Master, the goal is simple: move the hole across the board and collect all tiles. However, each tile puzzle introduces different formations, stacked tile clusters, compact tile grids, and layered tile layouts that change how you approach the board. You must plan your path to avoid blocking future movement while clearing every tile.
Core Tile Hole Gameplay
• Drag to move the hole freely across the board
• Swallow tiles by positioning the hole correctly
• Clear all tiles to complete the level
• Avoid bombs and blocked zones
• Use boosters to manage dense tile formations
• Progress through increasingly structured tile boards
The tile hole mechanic focuses on movement precision and spatial awareness. Because tiles are arranged in structured formations, clearing one area too quickly may limit access to other tile groups. Careful path planning becomes essential as tile layouts grow more complex.

Tile Puzzle Design
Tile Hole Master is built around tile collection and board clearing strategy. Each tile puzzle level introduces different board shapes and tile arrangements. Some boards feature compact tile stacks. Others include layered tile blocks that require gradual clearing.
The puzzle design emphasizes tile grouping and tile flow. Understanding how tiles connect and how the hole moves across the surface is key to solving each stage. Tile collect strategy becomes more important as levels increase in density and obstacle placement.

Themed Tile Collections
Throughout progression, the tile visuals evolve into themed tile worlds while maintaining the same tile hole mechanic. The themes change the appearance of the tiles but preserve the structured tile puzzle gameplay.
Each theme introduces a fresh tile environment while keeping the tile collect and board clear objective consistent. The themed tiles create visual variety without changing the core hole puzzle structure.

Mahjong-Style Tile Layouts
Some levels feature mahjong-style tile layouts, inspired by structured tile stacks and patterned tile formations. These mahjong-style tile boards focus on arrangement awareness and board clearing order.
While Tile Hole Master is not a traditional mahjong match game, the visual tile structures may resemble mahjong tile stacks. The gameplay remains centered on moving the hole, swallowing tiles, and clearing the board.
Obstacles and Boosters: As tile boards become denser, additional elements appear:
Boosters help manage complex tile formations by supporting tile clearing in crowded areas. Strategic use of boosters can assist in finishing structured tile layouts.

Strategic Board Clearing
Tile Hole Master focuses on:
• Tile movement strategy
• Board awareness
• Spatial puzzle solving
• Tile grouping efficiency
• Structured board clearing
Each tile hole puzzle requires analyzing the tile layout before making large movements. Efficient tile collection prevents the hole from getting trapped by remaining tile blocks.

3D Tile Interaction
The 3D environment enhances tile depth and tile stacking visibility. You move the hole around elevated tile blocks, dense tile clusters, and layered tile formations. This adds dimension to the tile puzzle experience while preserving the core tile collect mechanic.

Tile Hole Master combines:
tile hole gameplay, tile puzzle structure, tile collect strategy, 3D tile boards, mahjong-style layouts, and evolving tile themes.
Every level centers on tile clearing, controlled movement, and structured puzzle design. Progress through themed tile worlds, refine your tile strategy, and clear each board by mastering the tile hole mechanic.

data.name: Yarnation: Unravel Flow
data.description_full:
Unravel the Threads. Complete the Pattern. Feel the Flow.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a relaxing yet deeply engaging sorting puzzle game where you unravel beautifully knitted artwork using colorful yarn bobbins. Instead of blasting or matching tiles, you carefully remove stitches in the correct order to clear each woven design piece by piece.

Every level feels like solving a handcrafted knitting puzzle.
Every move shapes the flow.
Every unravel delivers a satisfying visual payoff.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, color sorting challenges, flow puzzles, and calm strategy-based gameplay, Yarnation: Unravel Flow offers a smooth and rewarding experience that keeps your mind active while staying relaxing.

🧶 A UNIQUE YARN PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Bobbins move along a conveyor system and collect stitches of their own color.
Each bobbin has a limited capacity that decreases as it gathers matching yarn stitches.

When a bobbin’s capacity reaches zero, it disappears.
If capacity remains, it returns to the rack, ready to be reused later.

This simple yet clever system creates a satisfying puzzle loop where:

• Color selection matters
• Order matters
• Planning matters
• Capacity management matters

Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right sequence.

🧠 STRATEGY OVER SPEED

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is not about frantic tapping.
It’s about smart decisions and smooth sequencing.

As you advance through the levels:

• Patterns become more layered and detailed
• Colors overlap and intertwine
• Rack space becomes limited
• Managing your moves becomes more important

You’ll need to analyze the layout carefully, think a few steps ahead, and maintain a clean unravel flow without blocking yourself.

It’s a logic puzzle at heart — calm, thoughtful, and deeply satisfying.

🎨 COZY KNITTED AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a warm and visually charming yarn world featuring:

• Soft knitted textures
• Handcrafted pixel-style artwork
• Clean and colorful stitch patterns
• Smooth unravel animations
• Clear visual feedback

Watching a detailed knitted image slowly unravel into completion creates a uniquely relaxing puzzle experience.

🔁 PROGRESSIVE PUZZLE DEPTH

With hundreds of handcrafted levels, Yarnation: Unravel Flow introduces new challenges throughout progression:

• Fresh stitch arrangements
• New color combinations
• Deeper sequencing logic
• Smarter rack usage

The difficulty curve remains smooth and accessible while offering enough depth to keep puzzle lovers engaged.

🎮 SIMPLE CONTROLS, DEEP GAMEPLAY

The one-tap control system keeps the experience intuitive and easy to learn.

But beneath that simplicity lies a strategy puzzle built around:

• Color sorting
• Flow management
• Capacity control
• Smart sequencing

Easy to start.
Satisfying to master.

READY TO UNRAVEL?

Pull the right thread.
Plan your sequence.
Complete every knitted pattern with precision.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a fresh take on sorting puzzles — calm, strategic, visually satisfying, and beautifully woven.
data.description_short: Unravel knitted patterns with smart yarn sorting puzzles.

data.name: Imposter Game: Who is the Spy?
data.description_full:
Listen closely and decide together - WHO IS THE IMPOSTER?

The Imposter game is built around one simple mechanic: most players know the secret word, and one does not. In every round of this imposter party word game, each person gives an association. One player must fake it and try to blend in.

The group talks, debates, and tries to find the impostor before it’s too late. Someone may confidently guess the imposter, while others wait and analyze who is the spy.


HOW TO PLAY
- See the word — or fake it if you didn’t.
- Give a clue.
- Discuss who is suspicious.
- Vote to find the impostor.

This imposter party word game is a hidden liar game, where subtle lying and careful listening decide the outcome. Players constantly try to find out who is lying, then they may challenge each other to explain their hints. When the discussion peaks, everyone will vote to guess the imposter.
In every imposter game, you must observe reactions and help the group find the impostor. Sometimes you immediately know who is the imposter; other times you hesitate, wondering who is lying while someone tries to fake it again!


Social deduction made simple: read people, think fast, and have fun!
Inspired by familiar unmask the spy game formats, this gameplay focuses on conversation and deduction—read behavior, control the situation and find who is the spy, or stay undercover and don't reveal yourself while guessing!

Listen carefully, analyze hints, and unmask the secret role. Each round challenges you to uncover the truth, even when someone stays completely under cover. Soon the room fills with questions: who imposter was acting strange? Who is lying about their clue? And finally — Who is the imposter?

PERFECT FOR GROUPS
It’s a simple game to play with friends! This flexible party game belongs in every collection of fun games to play with friends—it works as a quick group game during gatherings, trips or night parties. It fits naturally, it's easy to start, and matches other classic fun party games.
You can launch an imposter game anywhere and begin an imposter party word game session in seconds. Whether you’re hosting a casual party game night or organizing spontaneous fun games to play with friends, the format keeps everyone involved.

Play again and fake it better. Listen closer. And find the impostor! In every imposter game, someone must stay undercover, others will guess the imposter, and then must decide who is the spy.

data.name: Stickman Sandbox World
data.description_full:
Stickman Sandbox World is a side-scrolling action game featuring the classic stick figure character. It offers a fun and engaging gameplay experience that combines skill and strategy. Focusing on the core theme of "comeback," players control a seemingly weak stick figure character, defeating enemies, unlocking skills, and upgrading equipment to gradually overcome obstacles and become a powerful force. The game is well-suited for the fragmented gaming experience prevalent on WeChat. The simple vector art style combined with smooth combat feedback makes every battle exhilarating. It offers easy-to-learn controls for beginners and in-depth combo strategies for experienced players. Stickman Sandbox World eschews complex storylines, focusing instead on fast-paced battles and level progression. Diverse level designs, unique character unlocks, and competitive modes make this game stand out from its competitors, making it a great choice for casual gaming. Each level is a journey of overcoming adversity to become powerful, using simple controls to tell a thrilling story of triumph.

Stickman Sandbox World Game Features

1. A minimalist art style combined with impactful combat: Stickman characters feature clean lines yet fluid movements. Attacks and skill releases are accompanied by unique particle effects. The stark contrast between the impactful punches and kicks of normal attacks and the wide-area explosions of special moves creates an immersive combat experience.

2. Diverse characters and skill system: Players can unlock three types of stickman characters: melee, ranged, and support. Each character possesses unique skills, which can be upgraded to unlock advanced effects. Combine different equipment to create your own unique comeback build.

Stickman Sandbox World Basic Gameplay Introduction

1. Controls use a virtual joystick + skill buttons. The joystick controls the stickman's movement and dodging, while the skill buttons correspond to normal attacks and two unique skills. Holding down a skill button charges up and releases a powerful effect, optimized for one-handed operation on mobile devices.

2. The core objective is character growth and level progression. Players earn coins and materials by clearing levels to upgrade character levels, unlock skills, and enhance equipment, gradually overcoming initial weaknesses to achieve a power comeback. 3. The levels incorporate interactive elements. Some scenes contain destructible obstacles and hidden supply points. Making good use of scene resources can reduce the difficulty of battles, helping you to successfully turn the tide and pass the levels, increasing the fun and strategy of the gameplay.

data.name: City of Dragon : Epic Battle
data.description_full:
Enter the Realm of Legends in "City of Dragon: Epic Battle"!

Are you ready to ascend to the skies and become the ultimate Dragon Master? Welcome to a vibrant fantasy world of floating islands, ancient magic, and endless adventure. In City of Dragon: Epic Battle, your journey begins with a single egg, but your destiny is to rule a kingdom of legendary beasts.

Collect and Hatch Over 200 Unique Species The world is teeming with mystical creatures waiting to be discovered. Your primary goal is to build the most impressive Dragoniary in the realm. Scour the lands for rare and exotic dragon eggs—from rugged, stone-encrusted Terra eggs to swirling, galaxy-filled Cosmic eggs. Bring them back to your sanctuary, place them in the incubator, and witness the magical moment they hatch into adorable baby dragons. With over 200 unique dragons to collect, including the electrifying Electro-Gold Dragon, the fierce Volcanic Wolf-Dragon, and the graceful Frost-Crystal Dragon, the thrill of discovery never ends.

Master the Art of Evolution and Breeding Your dragons won't stay little forever. Nurture your squad and witness awe-inspiring transformations through a deep Evolution System. Watch as cute, chibi hatchlings grow into majestic, powerful behemoths, gaining incredible new forms and massive power boosts. Want something truly unique? Step into the Breeding Den! Combine different elemental dragons to discover rare hybrids. Fuse a standard Dragon with a Lion material to create the exclusive, powerful "Dralion." The possibilities for creating the perfect team are endless.

Strategic Elemental Combat More than just collecting, this is a world of conflict. You must assemble a powerful team to fight in Epic Battles. Success on the battlefield depends on mastering elemental advantages. Utilize the scorching fury of Fire, the freezing crowd-control of Ice, the swift strikes of Electro, the resilient power of Nature, and the mysterious energies of Light and Dark. Strategize your lineup to counter enemy weaknesses and dominate the battlefield with flashy, devastating visual effects.

Build Your Sky Kingdom Construct habitats on magical floating islands to house your growing collection. Manage your resources, level up your beasts, and prepare them for the challenges ahead. From battling wild monsters to challenging other players, only the strongest Dragon Masters will prevail.

The City of Dragons awaits its champion. Will you hatch the rarest eggs, evolve the strongest team, and lead them to victory? Download "City of Dragon: Epic Battle" now and start your legendary adventure!
data.description_short: Hatch, evolve, and battle! Collect 200+ dragons in City of Dragon: Epic Battle.

Experience the thrill of Omi4, Sri Lanka’s beloved traditional card game, now on your mobile device! Whether you’re a seasoned player or new to the game, Omi App brings the full traditional experience to life with smooth gameplay, vibrant graphics, and multiplayer action.

Key Features:
1. Onboarding & User Management
Multi-Language Support
Interactive Tutorial


2. Core Gameplay Modes
Single Player
Quick Play
Multiplayer
Play with Friends


3. Multiplayer Infrastructure
Friends Lobby
Matchmaking
Connection Handling


4. In-Game Mechanics & UI
Trump Card Selection
Dynamic Pop-Ups
Last Round Review
Card & Board Skins


5. Economy & Customization
My Wallet
In-App Shop
Leaderboard
Settings

How to Play Omi4:
Objective:
Win the highest number of tricks each round to earn tokens and
secure victory.

Dealing Cards:
Omi4 uses a 32-card deck (from the standard 52-card pack).
Each player receives two batches of four cards, totaling eight
cards per player.

Choosing the Trump Suit:
The player to the dealer’s right selects the trump suit,
which outranks all other suits for that round.

Leading the First Trick:
The player who chose the trump suit leads the first trick.
Other players must follow suit if possible; otherwise,
they may play any card.

Winning Tricks:
The highest card of the suit led wins the trick unless a trump
card is played. If a trump is played, the highest trump wins.
The trick winner leads the next round.

Counting Tricks & Tokens:
5–7 tricks with the trump suit: 1 token for the trump
team. 5–7 tricks without the trump suit: 2 tokens
for the other team.
Winning all 8 tricks: 3 tokens (“Kapothi”).
If both teams win 4 tricks each, no tokens transfer;
the next winning team earns an extra token.

Winning the Game:
The first team to reach 10 tokens or more wins the game
and becomes the ultimate Sinhala Omi champion!

data.name: BALL x PIT
data.description_full:
BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.

BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

data.description_full:
1. Game Rules
The core gameplay of Flower Power: The Art of Blooming revolves around matching and clearing tiles with identical patterns. Below the playing field, there is a slot that can hold up to 7 tiles. Clicking on a tile automatically places it into this slot. When 3 tiles with the same pattern are in the slot, they will be instantly cleared.

- Tip: You have a maximum of 7 moves per round to clear three tiles of the same design! If the slot fills up without matching three tiles, you lose. Every move counts!

- Layered Tiles: Some tiles may have multiple layers. Only after removing the top layer can you select and clear the lower layers.

- Winning Condition: Once no tiles remain on the board, you have successfully completed the level!

data.name: Scary Shawarma Horror Game
data.description_full:
Scary Shawarma Horror Game is a first-person horror experience that turns a normal shawarma kiosk into a terrifying nightmare. What looks like a simple cooking game and shop simulator quickly becomes a dark and intense survival story. You work alone at night inside a small food shop, preparing shawarma for late customers. At first, it feels like a normal cooking game where you slice meat, add sauces, wrap bread, and serve orders on time.

But this is not just a regular shop simulator. This is a haunted horror kiosk filled with fear. Strange sounds echo through the scary shop. Lights flicker again and again. The fridge door opens and closes by itself. The security cameras show strange shadows. The kiosk anomaly begins slowly, and you start to realize this is not an ordinary shawarma kiosk.

Customers in this scary shawarma shop behave in unusual ways. Some stand silently and stare. Some whisper strange words. Some order strange scary food that does not make sense. As you continue playing this horror cooking experience, the tension grows again and again. The small space of the horror kiosk makes you feel trapped, and every sound feels dangerous.

The game mixes cooking game mechanics with survival fear. You must complete orders quickly like a real shop simulator, but you must also survive the kiosk anomaly. The scary shop changes around you. Walls look different. Shadows move again and again. The once normal food shop becomes a place of darkness.

This scary shawarma adventure is more than just jump scares. It builds fear with silence, darkness, and sudden noises. The horror cooking theme makes it unique because you are always busy preparing scary food while something unknown watches you. In this shawarma kiosk, every task feels risky. In this horror kiosk, every second feels heavy.

What starts as my scary night shift becomes a fight to survive inside the scary shop. The kiosk anomaly keeps happening again and again, making the cooking game more intense. Scary Shawarma Horror Game combines shop simulator and survival fear to create a truly unforgettable horror kiosk experience.

data.name: Berry Blast Pop
data.description_full:
Berry Blast Pop is a calming, mind-stimulating puzzle game crafted for pure stress relief. Unlike most match-3 titles, there are no harsh timers or ticking countdowns to rush you. Your objective is straightforward: tap any cluster of two or more identically colored blocks to wipe them away. String together bigger combos to rack up huge point totals!
How to Play
1. Tap, Match & Score: Tap any group of connected same-color blocks (either horizontally or vertically) to erase them and gain points with every clear.
2. Go Big for Bigger Rewards: The more blocks you eliminate with a single tap, the higher your combo score climbs—bigger clusters mean massive point boosts!
3. Clear the Grid to Conquer the Level: Each stage ends when no more connected same-color blocks are left on the board. Your final score will decide if you pass the level and unlock the next challenge.
Berry Blast Pop comes packed with countless levels that ramp up in difficulty step by step. To move forward, you’ll need to hit higher score goals as you take on more challenging later stages. Boasting a sleek, minimalist design and focused gameplay—no over-the-top distractions, just simple, deeply satisfying puzzle fun—it’s the ideal way to unwind and make the most of your free time.

-Simple, Intuitive Swipe Controls
Just swipe to move cards around. Once two cards connect, they lock together so you can drag them as one “group”—smooth, effortless, and super satisfying.
-Addictive Chain Snaps
Line up multiple cards and trigger a “snap-snap-snap” chain reaction as they lock in at once. That rush is hard to resist—you’ll always want one more round.

Easy for beginners, rewarding for experts who love optimizing their moves and layout. Great for commutes, quick breaks, or relaxing before bed.

-Swipe to Move Cards
Swipe on the screen to drag cards wherever you want.
-Snap & Move Connected Cards Together
When a card is placed correctly, it “clicks” into position and connects. Connected cards can then be moved as a single group.
-Watch Out for Overlaps & Size Changes
If a smaller card is placed on top of a larger one, the larger card may temporarily shrink. Keep an eye on size changes and combine cards carefully to avoid confusion.

Simple to play, yet surprisingly strategic: plan your layout, avoid blocking key pieces, and set up satisfying chain snaps. If you love jigsaw puzzles, card-style organizing, or just want a relaxing and addictive brain game—give it a try today!

If you love a good color water sort or sorting puzzle, you're going to feel right at home here. We designed this game to be the perfect little escape for your brain—whether you're waiting in line, boring on the subway, lounging on the couch, or just winding down before bed.

🌊 Why you'll love playing Aqua Twist:
- Ultimate ASMR Vibes: There is something deeply satisfying about watching the liquids flow and mix. The gentle, ASMR-style pouring is incredibly relaxing and the absolute best way to kill some free time.

- Easy on the Eyes: We know bright screens can be a lot, so we picked gorgeous, soothing color palettes. The visuals are super nice for your eyes, meaning you can play comfortably for as long as you want.

- Gentle Brain Training: While the vibe is totally relaxed, figuring out the right logic to sort the water is actually a fantastic, low-stress workout for your brain. It keeps your mind sharp without making you sweat!

- Zero Pressure (No Timers!): Take a deep breath. There are absolutely no ticking clocks here. You can take all the time you need to plan your moves and just enjoy the process at your own pace.

- Fun Challenges & Unique Tubes: As you progress, you'll discover totally unique tubes, beautifully shaped flasks, and fun challenge levels that keep things fresh without ever feeling frustrating.

💧 How to play:
- Tap any tube to pick it up, then tap another to pour the water.

- Match the colors! You can only pour water if the top color of both tubes matches and there’s enough room.

- Sort it out: Keep pouring until each tube holds just one solid color. You win!

- Got stuck? No worries at all. You can easily undo a move or add an extra empty tube whenever you need a little help.

Ready to relax and get your flow on? Download Aqua Twist - Color Flow Puzzle today and treat your brain to a well-deserved break!
data.description_short: Tap the tubes, sort color water, beat the challenge and relax your mind

data.name: Башни и Герои: Война Миров
data.description_full:
«Башни и Герои: Война Миров» — Искусство башенной обороны, где ваша тактика решает всё!

Ядро игры: бесконечно разнообразная стратегия обороны
Каждая локация — это холст для вашего тактического гения. Огромное количество уникальных карт, от извилистых троп до сложных лабиринтов, от открытых полей до неприступных ущелий — каждая битва ставит новую стратегическую задачу. Классический геймплей башенной защиты выведен на новый уровень: типы башен, комбинации навыков, пути улучшений и распределение ресурсов — каждое ваше решение меняет ход сражения. Испытайте свои пределы в режиме «Испытание Бездны», где бесконечные волны врагов проверят вашу оборону на прочность.

Соревновательный PvP: битва умов на вершине
Искусство обороны — это не только защита, но и интеллектуальное противостояние с сильнейшими! От «Полигона Тактики», где проверяются основы, до «Небесного Рейтинга» для элиты и легендарной межсерверной лиги «Война Святилищ» — здесь создана целая экосистема для истинных стратегов. Покажите свой уникальный стиль защиты, изучите тактики лучших игроков мира и станьте мастером башенной обороны в битве стратегий.

Герои и оборона: стройте идеальную защитную систему
Герои — это не просто воины, а ключевые элементы вашей обороны! Легендарные герои открывают эксклюзивные навыки для башен, эпические герои дают уникальные усиления. Получите легендарного командира обороны при входе в игру, открывайте редких мастеров-строителей, проходя уровни. Система синергии между героями и башнями меняет правила игры: маг огня усиливает огненные башни, паладин даёт щиты, ассасин усиливает ловушки. Создайте свою непобедимую комбинацию!

Умный прогресс: наслаждайтесь сутью тактики
Мы вернулись к истокам жанра — радость стратегии не должна тонуть в рутине. Уникальная система офлайн-развития позволяет вашей обороне совершенствоваться постоянно. Никакого монотонного гринда и обязательных входов в игру. Каждая ваша сессия — это новые тактические вызовы. Ваше время посвящено только оптимизации построек, изучению тактик и соревновательным боям — чистому и глубокому искусству башенной обороны.

«Башни и Герои: Война Миров» — Здесь нет места простому накоплению силы, только продуманным построениям. Здесь нет побед через превосходство в статистиках, только через интеллектуальное превосходство. Присоединяйтесь и станьте архитектором победы!

data.name: Horror Shawarma & Patience
data.description_full:
Horror Shawarma & Patience is a scary horror simulator where an ordinary job at a shawarma kiosk slowly turns into a disturbing psychological nightmare.

DAY — SHAWARMA KIOSK

By day, you are just a simple worker in a small shawarma kiosk.
You cook tasty shawarma, take orders, keep the place clean, throw out the trash, and try to grow your tiny business.
It’s a normal workday — just like millions of other workers live every day.

Many customers pass through your kiosk.
Some of them feel too strange, others are openly unsettling.
Someone stares for too long. Someone says inappropriate things.
Some customers come back again and again, smiling in a way that feels wrong.
What if they’re not even human?

But you endure it.
That’s work.
You need patience.
Nothing scary… right?

NIGHT — HORROR AND INSOMNIA

When the kiosk closes, a completely different game begins.

At night, the work simulator turns into true domestic psychological horror.
You can’t sleep. Strange sounds echo through your apartment. Shadows move.
Unsettling visions follow you from room to room.

You keep doing everyday things — cooking food, cleaning, trying to relax —
but fear slowly crawls into your mind.
Your patience starts to fade, and it feels like you’re losing your grip on reality.

DON’T WATCH TOO LONG

You decide to face the fear and understand what’s happening.
You walk to the window and grab your binoculars.
Lights are on in the building across the street.
Clearly, you’re not the only one awake tonight.

Your patience — is running out, and you start watching your neighbors.
First out of curiosity.
Then out of anxiety.

But don’t watch for too long.
What begins as patience can turn into obsession —
and obsession can turn into a real nightmare.

The longer you look, the scarier it becomes.
Ordinary scenes twist into something horrifying.
And the feeling that someone is watching you back never goes away.

How do you survive until morning
just to return to another shift at the shawarma kiosk?

GAME FEATURES
- Shawarma kiosk work simulator
- Strange and terrifying visitors
- Psychological horror and everyday fear
- Watching mechanics and growing paranoia
- Atmosphere of anxiety, exhaustion, and insomnia
- Slow transformation of routine into a nightmare
- A constant test of your terpenie and sanity

This is a game about work, watching, and consequences.
About patience that slowly breaks.
About a nightmare that begins when you think everything is under control.

Download Horror Shawarma & Patience and try to survive the night.
data.description_short: Cook shawarma by day kiosk work. Test your terpenie at night watching neighbors
